lines.zh: 我在深层的石缝间慢慢走。
lines.en: I walk slowly through the deep's stone seams.

lines.zh: 脚步落下，回音总是双份。
lines.en: My footfalls land, and the echo comes doubled.

lines.zh: 黑暗替我掩住身形。
lines.en: The dark does the work of hiding my shape.

lines.zh: 我不赶路，你迟早会停下。
lines.en: I am in no rush; sooner or later you stop.

lines.zh: 石壁把我的呼吸放大了两倍。
lines.en: The walls amplify my breathing to twice its size.

lines.zh: 我沿着隧道一路逼近。
lines.en: I close in along the tunnel, step by step.

lines.zh: 关节走着走着就开始发颤。
lines.en: My joints start trembling as I walk.

lines.zh: 深层没有风，只有我的响动。
lines.en: No wind in the deep, only the noise I make.

lines.zh: 三十五个心跳压着地面走。
lines.en: Thirty-five heartbeats press the floor as I walk.

lines.zh: 拐过这个弯，就到你面前。
lines.en: Past this bend, I will be right in front of you.

lines.zh: 我把重心压向前方。
lines.en: I shift my weight forward.

lines.zh: 每一步都敲出两下响声。
lines.en: Every step knocks out two beats instead of one.

lines.zh: 我停住，频率在皮下低响。
lines.en: I halt, and a low frequency hums under my skin.

lines.zh: 深层的石头从不说话。
lines.en: The stones of the deep never speak.

lines.zh: 我在等你的耐心先断。
lines.en: I wait for your patience to break first.

lines.zh: 原地站着，我也在数拍子。
lines.en: Standing still, I am still counting beats.

lines.zh: 我的震动把灰尘抖下来。
lines.en: My trembling shakes the dust off the ceiling.

lines.zh: 这里离地面很远，光到不了。
lines.en: The surface is far; no light reaches here.

lines.zh: 我不需要睡眠，只需要声音。
lines.en: I do not need sleep, only sound.

lines.zh: 深层安静得能听见两次心跳。
lines.en: The deep is quiet enough to hear two heartbeats.

lines.zh: 我的影子在墙上多出一个。
lines.en: My shadow on the wall multiplies into a second one.

lines.zh: 听，我的停顿也有回音。
lines.en: Listen: even my pauses come back as echoes.

lines.zh: 你举着火把，我看得清楚。
lines.en: You hold up a torch; now I see you clearly.

lines.zh: 你站着不动，正合我意。
lines.en: You stand still, which suits me very well.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸在隧道里放大了。
lines.en: Your breathing is amplified down this tunnel.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，像盯着节拍。
lines.en: I fix on you the way I fix on a beat.

lines.zh: 你的灯光让我关节发痒。
lines.en: Your torchlight makes my joints itch.

lines.zh: 我们之间只剩八步。
lines.en: Only eight steps remain between us.

lines.zh: 我歪头，听你身上的铁器。
lines.en: I tilt my head, listening to the iron on you.

lines.zh: 你在犹豫要不要退。
lines.en: You are deciding whether to back away.

lines.zh: 我没有眼睑，眨不了眼。
lines.en: No eyelids on me, so I cannot blink.

lines.zh: 看你一眼，我就记住位置。
lines.en: One look at you, and I have your position.

lines.zh: 砍下去吧，我还有三十五颗心。
lines.en: Keep cutting; I still have thirty-five hearts.

lines.zh: 你的刀只削掉一层石皮。
lines.en: Your blade only shaves off a layer of stone skin.

lines.zh: 疼是好事情，说明我还站着。
lines.en: Pain is good; it means I am still standing.

lines.zh: 这一道口子会自己合上。
lines.en: This gash will close itself in time.

lines.zh: 震动被打乱了一瞬。
lines.en: My vibration is knocked out of rhythm for a moment.

lines.zh: 你听，回声变了调。
lines.en: Listen: the echo has changed its pitch.

lines.zh: 我只退了半步，没有更多。
lines.en: Half a step back, and not a finger more.

lines.zh: 打我也不会掉东西。
lines.en: Strike me all you like; nothing will drop.

lines.zh: 疼让我的拳头更准。
lines.en: The pain only makes my fists more accurate.

lines.zh: 我的裂口里没有血。
lines.en: There is no blood inside my cracks.

lines.zh: 你拿什么来，我都不吃。
lines.en: Bring anything you like; I eat none of it.

lines.zh: 举高也没用，我只要近身。
lines.en: Raise it higher; I only want to get close.

lines.zh: 你把食物翻倍，我也不换。
lines.en: Double the food and I still will not trade.

lines.zh: 我的饥饿是另一种频率。
lines.en: My hunger runs on a different frequency.

lines.zh: 你晃那东西，我只听见心跳。
lines.en: You wave it about; I only hear your heartbeat.

lines.zh: 食物收起来，我不碰。
lines.en: Put the food away; I will not touch it.

lines.zh: 我靠近不是因为香。
lines.en: I close in for reasons other than smell.

lines.zh: 你在拖延，我在数步子。
lines.en: You are stalling; I am counting steps.

lines.zh: 深层里没有可吃的东西。
lines.en: There is nothing edible down in the deep.

lines.zh: 别喂我，喂了也白费。
lines.en: Do not feed me; it would be wasted.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，像撞一堵震动的墙。
lines.en: You hit me like a wall that will not stop shaking.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，回音叠成四份。
lines.en: We collide, and the echo stacks up fourfold.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞得我退了半步。
lines.en: Your shoulder knocks me back half a step.

lines.zh: 我不躲，撞回来更省事。
lines.en: I do not dodge; hitting back is simpler.

lines.zh: 石头被我们挤得直响。
lines.en: The stones grind loudly where we push.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的脚，我记下了。
lines.en: You stepped on my foot; I have noted it.

lines.zh: 这窄道容不下两个人。
lines.en: This narrow passage cannot hold two of us.

lines.zh: 我的震动顺着你的手臂传上去。
lines.en: My trembling climbs up your arm.

lines.zh: 别挤，后面就是石壁。
lines.en: Stop shoving; the stone wall is right behind.

lines.zh: 撞完这一下，我就贴住你。
lines.en: After this impact, I will stay pressed to you.

lines.zh: 同频的两个，才走得齐。
lines.en: Only two on the same frequency walk in step.

lines.zh: 它踩一步，我踩一步。
lines.en: It takes a step; I take a step.

lines.zh: 我们并排走，回音合成一个。
lines.en: Side by side, our echoes merge into one.

lines.zh: 深层太静，两个正好。
lines.en: The deep is too quiet; two is just right.

lines.zh: 它比我慢，正好压住后路。
lines.en: It is slower than me, which guards the rear.

lines.zh: 我们不需要言语，只要节拍。
lines.en: We need no words, only the beat.

lines.zh: 同频时，脚步声会重合成一。
lines.en: In tune, our footfalls collapse into one.

lines.zh: 它先动，我跟上半拍。
lines.en: It moves first; I follow half a beat later.

lines.zh: 两个影子叠成一个更深的。
lines.en: Two shadows overlap into one darker shape.

lines.zh: 我们的呼吸轮流填满黑暗。
lines.en: Our breathing takes turns filling the dark.

lines.zh: 我不捡东西，也不要东西。
lines.en: I pick nothing up and want nothing.

lines.zh: 地上那块铁，你自己收好。
lines.en: That iron on the floor, keep it yourself.

lines.zh: 我的手只用来打人。
lines.en: My hands are for striking, nothing else.

lines.zh: 你丢下的，我不会替你拿。
lines.en: What you drop, I will not carry for you.

lines.zh: 捡起来还得放下，麻烦。
lines.en: Picking it up means putting it down again; tedious.

lines.zh: 我对物品没有兴趣。
lines.en: I have no interest in items.

lines.zh: 你掉的那把剑，我不碰。
lines.en: The sword you dropped, I will not touch it.

lines.zh: 深层里石头比东西多。
lines.en: The deep holds more stone than loot.

lines.zh: 捡东西会耽误追人。
lines.en: Picking things up would delay the chase.

lines.zh: 我死后什么也不留。
lines.en: When I die, I leave nothing behind.

lines.zh: 你踏进三十格，我就知道了。
lines.en: You crossed thirty blocks, and I knew.

lines.zh: 震动传到我脚底，是你。
lines.en: A tremor reaches my feet; it is you.

lines.zh: 我锁住你，像锁住一个频率。
lines.en: I lock onto you like locking onto a frequency.

lines.zh: 这声音我找了一整层。
lines.en: I have searched a whole layer for this sound.

lines.zh: 你还会走，但方向我记下了。
lines.en: You may still walk, but I have your heading.

lines.zh: 从你第一次落脚开始。
lines.en: It began with your very first footfall.

lines.zh: 我听见你腰间的水壶在晃。
lines.en: I hear the canteen swinging at your waist.

lines.zh: 锁定完成，剩下只是距离。
lines.en: Lock complete; what remains is only distance.

lines.zh: 你身后那盏灯抖了一下。
lines.en: The lamp behind you flickered once.

lines.zh: 我选你，不选你旁边的。
lines.en: I choose you, not the one beside you.

lines.zh: 呼吸声在石块间反弹回来。
lines.en: Your breath bounces back between the stones.

lines.zh: 我记下你的节拍，比脚步快。
lines.en: I have your tempo; it runs faster than your feet.

lines.zh: 你退得再快也没用。
lines.en: Retreat faster if you like; it changes nothing.

lines.zh: 我转头，只为对准你。
lines.en: I turn my head only to aim at you.

lines.zh: 你踩下来的那一下，比石头重。
lines.en: That step of yours landed heavier than stone.

lines.zh: 两条腿的声音，我分得清哪条是你的。
lines.en: Two sets of legs; I can tell which one is yours.

lines.zh: 距离在我脚下一点点缩。
lines.en: The gap shrinks under my feet, bit by bit.

lines.zh: 你转左，我也跟着转左。
lines.en: Turn left, and my turn follows yours.

lines.zh: 别回头，我会在那里。
lines.en: Do not look back; I will be there.

lines.zh: 你在跑，我在走，这就够了。
lines.en: You run, I walk; that is enough.

lines.zh: 我的脚步越走越快。
lines.en: My pace keeps quickening as I follow.

lines.zh: 你换了三次方向，我都看见。
lines.en: You changed direction three times; I saw each.

lines.zh: 石壁把你的线路挤窄了。
lines.en: The walls narrow the route you chose.

lines.zh: 我不用嗅，震动就够。
lines.en: I do not need scent; the tremor is enough.

lines.zh: 你停，我也停，看清楚。
lines.en: You stop, I stop, and we both look.

lines.zh: 距离正在减半。
lines.en: The distance is halving with every breath.

lines.zh: 我不跑，因为不必跑。
lines.en: I do not run, because I do not need to.

lines.zh: 你的火把光在我前面晃。
lines.en: Your torchlight sways ahead of me.

lines.zh: 每个转角我都提早一步。
lines.en: At every corner I arrive a step early.

lines.zh: 你听得见我，却甩不掉我。
lines.en: You hear me coming and still cannot shake me.

lines.zh: 我停一步，让你以为我丢了。
lines.en: I stop for a step, so you think you lost me.

lines.zh: 你的回声在石壁上多绕了半圈。
lines.en: Your echo circles the stone wall half a turn longer.

lines.zh: 我把手贴在石壁上，读你的脚步。
lines.en: I press my hand to the wall and read your footsteps.

lines.zh: 你换了鞋子，声音轻了，可还是你。
lines.en: You changed your boots; quieter, but still you.

lines.zh: 这条隧道只有两头，你走不掉。
lines.en: This tunnel has only two ends. You cannot leave.

lines.zh: 我慢慢加速，节拍越来越密。
lines.en: I speed up slowly, my beat growing denser.

lines.zh: 这一下八点，你数着。
lines.en: This one lands for eight; keep count.

lines.zh: 我的拳头落下时带着嗡响。
lines.en: My fist comes down with a humming sound.

lines.zh: 挨打之后你才明白距离。
lines.en: After the hit you finally understand distance.

lines.zh: 别挡，挡了震得更疼。
lines.en: Do not block; blocking only spreads the ache.

lines.zh: 两下并作一下打出去。
lines.en: Two blows leave my hand as one.

lines.zh: 你的护甲把声音弹回来。
lines.en: Your armor throws the sound right back at me.

lines.zh: 我打到骨头，声音很闷。
lines.en: I strike bone, and the sound comes out muffled.

lines.zh: 退一步，我再补一次。
lines.en: Step back, and I will follow with another.

lines.zh: 这一拳带着深层的凉气。
lines.en: This punch carries the deep's cold air with it.

lines.zh: 你的手抖，我数得清。
lines.en: Your hands shake; I can count the tremors.

lines.zh: 我打你，不为吃，只为结束。
lines.en: I strike you not to feed, but to end it.

lines.zh: 你的盾牌凹了一小块。
lines.en: A small dent has appeared in your shield.

lines.zh: 再站近点，我更好出手。
lines.en: Stand a little closer; it helps my swing.

lines.zh: 打中一次，我就占住位置。
lines.en: One hit lands, and I hold the ground.

lines.zh: 两拳落下，石壁上掉了两层灰。
lines.en: Two fists land, and two layers of dust fall from the wall.

lines.zh: 我打你的膝盖，让你跪在同一处。
lines.en: I hit your knee so you kneel in the same spot.

lines.zh: 这一下带着锈味，你尝到了吗。
lines.en: This one tastes of rust. Did you notice?

lines.zh: 你退了，我的拳头跟着你的胸口。
lines.en: You retreat, and my fist follows your chest.

lines.zh: 打中时，我听见两声闷响。
lines.en: When I connect, I hear two dull thuds.

lines.zh: 我不追你快，我只打你稳。
lines.en: I do not chase your speed; I strike where you stand steady.

lines.zh: 石缝里先有震动，才有我。
lines.en: First the tremor in the seam, then me.

lines.zh: 我从深层的黑里挤出来。
lines.en: I squeeze out of the deep's blackness.

lines.zh: 灯照不到的地方就够了。
lines.en: A patch the lamps cannot reach is enough.

lines.zh: 石头裂开，我站直身子。
lines.en: The stone splits, and I straighten up.

lines.zh: 这里的回声终于有了主人。
lines.en: The echoes here finally have an owner.

lines.zh: 我出现的频率很低，别错过。
lines.en: I appear rarely; do not miss it.

lines.zh: 黑暗先动，我才动。
lines.en: The dark moves first; then I do.

lines.zh: 一个新的节拍落在隧道里。
lines.en: A new beat settles into the tunnel.

lines.zh: 石屑落尽，我已在原地。
lines.en: The stone dust settles, and I am already here.

lines.zh: 你脚下那块地开始发麻。
lines.en: The ground under your feet begins to numb.

lines.zh: 我从没有光的一侧来。
lines.en: I come from the side with no light.

lines.zh: 又一个我，在这个层里。
lines.en: Another one of me, on this layer.

lines.zh: 火把我的震动烤成杂音。
lines.en: Fire bakes my vibration into noise.

lines.zh: 落地时我的关节错开半寸。
lines.en: On landing, my joints slip half an inch apart.

lines.zh: 水灌进石缝，我不出声。
lines.en: Water floods my seams; I make no sound.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我震得满嘴石渣。
lines.en: The blast leaves grit in my mouth.

lines.zh: 箭扎进我身上，只露一个尾。
lines.en: The arrow lodges in me, only its fletching showing.

lines.zh: 那道光让我的频率乱跳。
lines.en: That light makes my frequency jump erratically.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，也照样站着。
lines.en: I eat nothing and stay standing anyway.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我整层都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning falls, and my whole layer lights up.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有回声，很难受。
lines.en: The void has no echoes, and that hurts.
